The plate looks like a small paper plate, roughly 20 cm across (about 260 px in the image). The almonds are about 2 cm long, which fits that scale.

I count roughly 30 almonds. Each weighs about 1.2 g, so the total is about 36 g.

Almonds have about 6 kcal per gram, so 36 g comes to roughly 215 kcal.
